ambiguities_or_notes: Tolstoy's letter body is French and is translated directly from French; the Soviet edition's Russian rendering is translated separately as apparatus rather than used as the English base text.
The deliberately unpolished self-reproach 'inconséquent et vilain' is rendered conservatively as 'inconsistent and bad'.
The audited Markdown assigns separate footnote IDs 4–8 to the editorial Russian rendering; those IDs and all duplicate note definitions are preserved rather than normalized away.
All three volume-page boundaries, the envelope, the publication note, and the complete eight-note apparatus are represented.
